title: sieve: RFC 5231 relational comparators
description: Implement RFC 5231 relational extension in crates/sieve/src/extensions/relational.rs. Activated by require 'relational'. Adds :value and :count match types to existing tests. :value <relop> compares a single string value using relational operator (gt, lt, ge, le, eq, ne) with the specified comparator. :count <relop> counts the number of values in a multi-valued header and compares count to argument using i;ascii-numeric. Supported comparators for :value: i;ascii-casemap (default), i;octet, i;ascii-numeric. For i;ascii-numeric: non-numeric strings sort less than numeric ones; comparison is by numeric value. Extend the evaluator's match-type dispatch to handle Value(RelOp) and Count(RelOp). Tests: header :value :gt, header :count :ge, address :value :eq, numeric comparator ordering, octet comparator byte ordering. Oracle: RFC 5231 §5 examples.
